---
title: "Model Overloaded"
sidebarTitle: "Model Overloaded (503)"
description: "The error returned when model capacity is temporarily insufficient."
---

## Error response

**Status code:** `503`

```json
{
  "error": {
    "message": "This model is currently under heavy load. Please switch to another model or try again later.",
    "type": "model_overloaded",
    "source": "system",
    "details": {
      "request_id": "2026061615330428374635",
      "note": "This error was generated by the system, not from any upstream provider."
    }
  }
}
```

This error is returned by the platform itself.

## Cause

The model currently lacks available capacity: every available channel is busy and cannot handle your request. This is a capacity issue and is unrelated to your request content, token, or account.

## How to fix

* **Retry later**: capacity usually recovers quickly; use exponential backoff
* **Switch models**: temporarily use a different model
* **Use the `default` route**: if you pinned a specific provider, try `default` instead and let the system route automatically, which usually has much more capacity. See [Provider routing](/en/docs/models-pricing/provider-routing)
* **Switch protocols**: some resources are only available under a particular protocol, so capacity is uneven across protocols. See [Protocols](/en/api-reference/introduction/protocols)

If the problem persists for a long time, contact the team with the `request_id`.
